qualification: Nine valid paired synthetic cases: ordinary prefixes, implicit defaults, empty prefix, lacing, whole-frame stripping, late tracks and two Opus-lace variants.
Decoder packet bytes/clocks, native VP9 pixels, seek, rewind, EOF and all Opus PCM match original controls.
Wholly stripped video transcodes to FFV1 with correct pixels; identity copies preserve every original byte and all packets.
Restored packet limits reject before changing caller buffers. Retained prefix capacity is included in index admission; audio and subtitle aggregate limits use restored sizes.
Packet offsets/sizes retain stored-file span semantics; the additive packet_payload_size method reports the restored codec input length.
Malformed lace count refusal and unsupported zlib refusal are distinct from successful header-stripping playback.

Scope is one frame-only header-stripping transform. Other compression, transform chains, codec-private compression and encryption remain unsupported. Prefix settings are bounded to 256 KiB and the packet limit.
Software runtime qualification only; the player configuration also type-checks. No hardware runtime or performance claim.
counting: One independently useful container capability. Fixtures, lacing/audio variants, resource checks and public-size accounting do not create additional improvement IDs.
